title: Fiscal Dominance and Global Determinacy
abstract: arXiv:2610.32963v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The existing literature on monetary-fiscal policy interactions emphasizes that an active monetary/passive fiscal policy regime causes global indeterminacy of equilibrium, supporting liquidity traps and self-fulfilling hyperinflations as possible equilibrium outcomes. In a nonlinear New Keynesian model with costly price adjustment, I show that an analogous critique, with different global macroeconomic dynamics, extends to a passive monetary/active fiscal policy regime whenever the fiscal response to government liabilities is below the steady-state real interest rate but positive. In this case, although the equilibrium is locally unique according to the Blanchard-Kahn conditions, there exist multiple inflation paths originating around the saddle path that converge asymptotically to the central bank's target rate while satisfying the private sector's transversality condition. translated_title: 财政主导与全局确定性
translated_abstract: 现有关于货币-财政政策互动的文献强调，主动货币/被动财政政策体制会导致均衡的全局不确定性，使得流动性陷阱和自我实现式恶性通胀可能成为均衡结果。在一个具有价格调整成本的非线性新凯恩斯模型中，我证明了一种类似的批评（但具有不同的全局宏观经济动态）也适用于被动货币/主动财政政策体制，只要财政对政府负债的反应低于稳态实际利率但为正。在这种情况下，尽管根据Blanchard-Kahn条件均衡在局部是唯一的，但存在多条起始于鞍点路径附近的通胀路径，它们在满足私人部门横截性条件的同时渐近收敛于中央银行的目标利率。我证明，全局确定性反而需要一种纯粹的……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 本文证明，即使在被动的货币政策与主动的财政政策（财政主导）体制下，只要财政对政府债务的反应为正但低于稳态实际利率，均衡虽然满足Blanchard-Kahn局部唯一性条件，但仍会出现全局不确定性，从而将全局不确定性问题从主动货币体制拓展到了财政主导体制。
en_tdlr: In a nonlinear New Keynesian model, this paper shows that global indeterminacy also arises under the passive monetary/active fiscal (fiscal dominance) regime whenever the fiscal response to government liabilities is positive but below the steady-state real interest rate, despite local determinacy under the Blanchard-Kahn conditions.
